summary: Forward Industries filed an 8-K disclosing two non-binding all-stock acquisition proposals. It made a proposal to SkyAI, Inc. (SKYA) in June 2026 to acquire all shares; SKYA did not respond by the June 12, 2026 expiration. It separately proposed to Solana Company (HSDT) for all shares; HSDT's board voted to decline and not engage further. No price per share, premium, or deal value was disclosed. Board recommendation is not applicable as these are rejected/expired offers. The filing notes the proposals were non-binding and Forward Industries operates a digital asset strategy. No advisors or closing timeline given. Watch for: any renewed bid or strategic pivot given the rejections.
